<function name="GetTaskID" parent="ai" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Translates a task name to its corresponding ID.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="task" type="string">The task name.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The task ID, see [ai_task.h](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/source-sdk-2013/blob/55ed12f8d1eb6887d348be03aee5573d44177ffb/mp/src/game/server/ai_task.h#L89-L502). Returns -1 if the schedule name isn't valid.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
